'''NovaCORE''' was a company based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It had a [[Kelerium/Legends|kelerium]] [[NovaCORE kelerium processing plant|processing plant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] where [[Kaa'to Leeachos]], a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], took shelter in the plant after he betrayed the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a powerful underworld syndicate, who subsequently dispatched a group of agents to apprehend the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]].
